issue.title: Successor card refusal shake never plays: successorShakeRow's querySelector guard is inverted

task_type_fields.impact: Every refusal on the Obsidian successor card shows only its status line, with no motion cue: verdict refusals since picker v4, and the new Ctrl+J "Jump works on offer rows only" refusal. This is cosmetic, but it is the feedback the design specifies. Fix: flip the guard to `typeof ... !== "function"`, and run the shake after the re-render, for example on the next frame against the new row element. Respect reduced motion as the code already does.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/206d (successorShakeRow) and its callers in 206c/206e

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-oe land review found that the Ctrl+J and verdict refusals on the Obsidian successor card never shake. The inverted guard predates the epic (8a16ebea), and the root cause is a one-line flip plus the shake/render ordering.
